it reads, ||Mender,||
||I apologise for leaving a message in this way - I feel the need to ask for your advice, but I need to rest, yet at the same time it would help if you knew the situation now.||
||I'll keep it brief - when we left after Finn's revival, we encountered Bo and his 'friend', and a commotion. Some sort of... meat creature that 'he' had given life to, was on a berserk rampage, and 'he' requested help in subduing it, preferably alive. It... was  an abomination, and since it was hurting people - it attempted to eat one of us, for one, and many people were fleeing in fear. I thought it best to disregard the 'alive' request.||
||As we were fighting it though, we noticed... it was sentient in some form, like a child, and in great pain from its... let's call it condition. We subdued it non-lethally, but I ended up persuading 'him' that it was better to put them out of their misery... A merciful death is better than a lifetime of suffering, right?||
||...I see why people wanted me dead now. I don't know if my own pain was as clear as it was here, but... I understand. That creature... they reminded me of me, and I was ultimately responsible for their death. I feel like it was an act of mercy, but they didn't ask for this fate...||
||If there's more important things to worry about, then I can wait to speak with you about it. Roy's helping me through it - he's always so [smudged] helpful - I should be alright by the time I wake up, just... If at all possible, I would like advice.||
||I appreciate; ----Sabrine||
